verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a hosted service, but nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-premises distribution of Mercado Pago. The docs describe a service run by Mercado Pago and consumed through its APIs, CLI and MCP server; for example, the ready-to-use checkout is a page hosted by Mercado Pago. Embedding the Checkout API on your own site is integration, not self-hosting the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
